integrity: Proof contains exact moment identities, complement Gram reduction and complete forbidden-pair classification; independently specified numerical 2002-subset census and symbolic exact checks furnished.
scientific_limitations: Fixed Lebedev fourteen-node quadrature with unchanged original weights, nine retained nodes and spherical-harmonic degree at most two; exact E-optimal spectral result, not an arbitrary-node optimum, noisy-stability guarantee, or independently certified historical novelty.
title: Sharp five-erasure stability for the fourteen-point spherical quadrature
